edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Ὡσαύτως καὶ αἱ τρεῖς ἡμέραι πρὸ τῶν φωστήρων γεγονυῖαι τύποι εἰσὶν τῆς τριάδος, τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ λόγου αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς σοφίας αὐτοῦ. Τετάρτῳ δὲ τύπῳ ἐστὶν ἄνθρωπος ὁ προσδεὴς τοῦ φωτός, ἵνα ᾖ θεός, λόγος, σοφία, ἄνθρωπος.
pass_a_gloss: Similarly also the three days which have come into being before the lights are types of the trinity, of God and of His Word and of His Wisdom. On the fourth day the man is a type, who has need of the light, so that God may be, Word may be, Wisdom may be, man may be.

choices.english: on the fourth day the man is a type

pass_b_english: Similarly, the three days that existed before the lights are types of the Trinity: God, His Word, and His Wisdom. On the fourth day, man is a type—the one who needs the light—so that God may be, Word may be, Wisdom may be, man may be.

anf_compare.notes: Drafted from source only; ANF not shown to drafter.

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Greek text. Pass A and Pass B both correctly render the purpose clause 'ἵνα ᾖ' as 'so that... may be' and the relationship between the man and the light 'ὁ προσδεὴς τοῦ φωτός'.
